highlights.title: Clearer public holidays in timesheets
highlights.description: Public holidays now use L with remarks such as Deepavali Holiday. Substitute labels are removed, and weekends stay blank.

highlights.title: Consistent Comp-Off timesheets
highlights.description: Full-day Comp-Off now uses L, with the selected holiday name followed by Comp-off in Remarks. Half days stay at 4.5 hours.

releaseNotes: Timesheets now mark weekday public holidays as L and use the holiday name followed by Holiday, without Substitute or Observed labels. HR leave totals include these L entries; app leave balances are unchanged. Full-day Comp-Off also uses L with the corresponding holiday name plus Comp-off; half-day working hours remain 4.5.
